# LayersDescriptor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Builder for the [`Layers`](layers.md) inline z-stacking primitive, used by `Container.layers(...)`. Layers paint in declaration order: background behind, the primary layer in the middle (it defines the flow height), and foreground on top.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new LayersDescriptor()
```

## Methods

- [`background`](#background): Adds a layer painted behind the primary layer.
- [`foreground`](#foreground): Adds a layer painted on top of the primary layer.
- [`primaryLayer`](#primarylayer): Sets the primary content layer - the layer that determines the flow height of the stack.

### `background`

```typescript
background(element: IElement): LayersDescriptor
```

Adds a layer painted behind the primary layer.

### `foreground`

```typescript
foreground(element: IElement): LayersDescriptor
```

Adds a layer painted on top of the primary layer.

### `primaryLayer`

```typescript
primaryLayer(element: IElement): LayersDescriptor
```

Sets the primary content layer - the layer that determines the flow height of the stack.
